baseline_models.focus_anchor: Words 2-5 couple maintained prayer with transferred zakat; words 7-9 place both under emphatic certainty about the later end.
baseline_models.mechanism: Sustained ritual maintenance and outward transfer form a present practice-system whose continuity is stabilized by knowledge of the later horizon.

activation_trace.role: Sustained care and guardianship make iqamah ongoing maintenance rather than a one-time performance.
The specified worship supplies the recurrent ritual being maintained.
The parallel mapped inventory reinforces prayer as binding embodied worship.
Giving supplies the outward transfer that prevents the practice-system from closing around the self.
Growth makes zakat productive increase rather than mere subtraction.
Purification adds reform of giver and resource to the transfer.
Laterness supplies the terminal horizon toward which the present acts are ordered.
Stable knowledge removes the horizon from the status of a speculative add-on.

changed_reading.before: Three adjacent marks of the pious: prayer, almsgiving, and belief in the afterlife.
changed_reading.after: A coupled discipline maintains worship, routes resources outward, and lets a settled later horizon govern present repetition.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence at words 2-5 can be read materially through support, channeling, yield, and growth, while words 7-9 add delayed stability.
baseline_models.mechanism: Prayer keeps the supporting structure upright; giving opens a channel through which received yield becomes further growth; certainty tolerates the delay between transfer and final outcome.

activation_trace.role: Support and subsistence cast iqamah as keeping the whole circuit viable.
A watercourse and its cleared route supply the image of directed circulation.
Incoming floodwater frames what is given as something first received from elsewhere.
Yield emerging from crop or palm connects receipt to renewable output.
Increase and growth name the result of keeping the channel open.
Deferral supplies the interval in which immediate loss can become later increase.
Firm knowledge keeps delayed return from collapsing the circuit.

changed_reading.before: Zakat is a discrete payment placed beside prayer.
changed_reading.after: Prayer and zakat maintain a circulation system: received provision is routed into growth whose decisive return may be delayed.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Words 2-3 bind bodily standing and straightness to prayer, while the doubled pronoun construction at words 6-9 concentrates the temporal conviction.
baseline_models.mechanism: Repeated bodily alignment trains resolve and straightness, allowing the later horizon to become an enacted orientation rather than a detached proposition.

activation_trace.role: Bodily standing gives the practice a posture and repeated physical form.
Rising with resolve turns posture into readiness for action.
Straightness and balance make alignment the practice's formative effect.
Obligatory prayer supplies the recurring embodied sequence that performs the alignment.
The later end gives the aligned body a direction beyond immediate conditions.
Certainty makes that direction behaviorally steady.

changed_reading.before: Prayer is one action and afterlife certainty is a separate belief.
changed_reading.after: The recurrent posture of prayer bodily rehearses the straight orientation that certainty about the later end requires.

context_deltas.mechanism: The purchased diversion in 31:6 and the non-compliant, weighted hearing in 31:7 recast 31:4 as a counter-economy: prayer repeatedly reallocates attention, zakat reallocates wealth, and certainty prevents both from being captured by immediate spectacle.

activation_trace.role: Maintenance makes prayer the repeated protection of an attentional commitment.
Giving supplies the rival allocation of material resources.
Stable knowledge supplies resistance to short-horizon capture.
Exchange makes diversion an acquired allocation, not merely a passing distraction.
Being occupied away from another thing supplies the displacement of attention.
Hearing as understanding and compliance identifies the failed action-link, not acoustic failure alone.
Weight in the ear materializes the blockage between address and response.

structural_cues: 31:6 progresses from purchase to diversion, misdirection, and mockery; 31:7 then turns from recitation to proud withdrawal and an ear-weight simile.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exchange, displacement, failed compliance, and ear-weight; I infer allocation -> formed agency, while a live alternative is that the two passages offer only a moral contrast with 31:4.

changed_reading.before: The verse lists devotional observances that mark an already pious person.
changed_reading.after: The observances actively defend where attention and wealth go, forming a person against a purchased economy of diversion.

context_deltas.mechanism: The creation sequence in 31:10 moves from stabilizing against sway to delivered water and paired growth. It activates the focus sequence as analogous infrastructure: prayer stabilizes, giving routes what arrives, and zakat turns circulation into renewable growth.

activation_trace.role: Support and subsistence let established prayer function as stabilizing infrastructure.
The cleared watercourse supplies the focus-side image of directed resource flow.
Yield connects giving to output that can recur.
Growth names the productive result of circulation.
Pairing keeps the growth model relational rather than solitary.
Firm anchoring supplies the stabilizing first phase of the creation mechanism.
Sway and disturbance identify what the stabilizing phase prevents.
Delivery from above supplies resource arrival before human routing.
Conveying water by irrigation concretizes the movement from arrival to distribution.
Plant emergence supplies visible multiplication after distribution.
A partner joined to its counterpart sharpens growth as a coupled ecology.

structural_cues: Within one ayah, anchoring against motion precedes descent of water, germination, and every noble pair.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered material sequence; I infer ecological flow -> a social-resource analogy in 31:4, while the live alternative is that 31:10 serves only as a creation proof and does not model the practices.

changed_reading.before: Prayer and zakat are two neighboring duties.
changed_reading.after: They can be carried as stabilizer and channel within one ecology of received provision, distributed flow, and paired growth.

context_deltas.mechanism: The maternal sequence in 31:14 carries a hidden burden through compounded weakness toward weaning. This activates iqamah and zakat as support whose success is not dependency but the recipient's eventual differentiated standing.

activation_trace.role: Care and guardianship make establishment a sustained support relation.
Giving supplies concrete support during vulnerability.
Growth defines the support's intended trajectory.
The inward load and fruit supply a model of support before its result is externally visible.
Compounded weakness identifies the real cost borne by the supporting side.
Weaning supplies separation and maturation as the endpoint of care.

structural_cues: 31:14 places carrying, repeated weakness, two years, weaning, gratitude, and return in one sequence; 31:15 preserves fitting companionship even where obedience stops.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies costly carrying -> weaning; I infer support -> capable separation for the focus's giving/growth pair, while a live alternative is that the family sequence only grounds gratitude to parents.

changed_reading.before: Zakat relieves a recipient's present lack.
changed_reading.after: Zakat can be read as costly developmental support that aims at growth into differentiated standing, not permanent dependence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's human giving and 31:16's divine bringing share the same root. A mustard seed hidden in rock but still brought forth makes afterlife certainty a warrant that even tiny, unseen transfers remain retrievable and consequential.

activation_trace.role: Human giving supplies the small outward act whose visibility may vanish.
Growth allows a small transfer to carry consequences larger than its visible size.
Stable knowledge holds the act's significance when no immediate return can be seen.
The mustard seed supplies the extreme smallness of the tracked thing.
Massive hard rock supplies apparent inaccessibility and concealment.
Coming and arrival make the concealed small thing recoverable into presence.
Fineness and hiddenness explain why retrieval is not blocked by scale or concealment.

structural_cues: 31:16 nests the seed successively in rock, heavens, or earth before the finite verb of bringing it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a shared root and hidden-small retrieval; I infer divine retrieval -> durable significance for human giving, while the live alternative is a general omniscience lesson with no special link to zakat.

changed_reading.before: Certainty in the afterlife motivates giving through a general promise of reward.
changed_reading.after: Certainty specifically trusts that no gift is too small, buried, or socially invisible to be brought into final consequence.

context_deltas.mechanism: 31:17 repeats the focus construction and immediately extends it into commanding, restraining, and enduring; 31:18-19 then calibrate gait and voice. Established prayer becomes posture training that propagates into public conduct without becoming domineering.

activation_trace.role: Standing supplies the bodily base from which conduct is trained.
Straightness and balance define the intended carryover beyond ritual.
Resolve and rising to the task make the repeated command an activation toward action.
The exact ritual repetition anchors the ensuing social disciplines back in prayer.
Request and obligation move formation outward into affirmative public action.
Restraint supplies the complementary blocking function.
Holding the self against panic makes public action sustainable under consequence.
Moderation between extremes regulates how formed agency moves.
Deliberate lowering gives the formed voice a restraint mechanism.
Audible voice supplies the public output that must remain calibrated.

structural_cues: The exact establish-prayer imperative opens 31:17; public imperatives follow, then 31:18-19 shift to cheek, walking, and voice.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ritual repetition -> social imperatives -> bodily calibration; I infer formation propagates along that sequence, while a live alternative treats each as adjacent but independent counsel.

changed_reading.before: Establishing prayer means preserving the ritual correctly.
changed_reading.after: Establishing prayer trains a straight, durable public agency whose command, restraint, gait, and voice are all kept within measure.

context_deltas.mechanism: Night and day enter one another while sun and moon run to an appointed limit, followed by the true/false contrast. The focus practices become a recurring cadence inside finite time, and afterlife certainty becomes allegiance to what remains stable when the appointed run ends.

activation_trace.role: Continuing maintenance lets prayer mark time by recurrence.
Deferral supplies the end not yet reached inside the present cycle.
Stable knowledge fixes orientation through changing cycles.
One temporal field entering another supplies recurrence without static repetition.
Continuous running supplies active movement through the allotted span.
A fixed terminal time gives the recurring movement a limit.
Reality-stable truth names what the cadence is aligned to.
Loss of truth and stability supplies the rival orientation that falls away.

structural_cues: 31:29 repeats mutual entry, names two runners and one appointed term, and 31:30 immediately resolves the sequence into truth versus falsehood.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies cyclical entry, running, limit, and ontological contrast; I infer cosmic cadence -> a temporal function for repeated practices, while the live alternative is that the cosmology only evidences divine power.

changed_reading.before: The afterlife is a distant object of belief appended to present duties.
changed_reading.after: The later end regulates the cadence of present duties: repetition spends finite time in alignment with what will remain true at its limit.

context_deltas.mechanism: 31:31-32 moves from a grace-driven ship to engulfing waves, exclusive devotion, rescue, and only partial moderation. The focus's maintained prayer, outward flow, and certainty become continuity infrastructure that can preserve devotion and gratitude across both danger and relief.

activation_trace.role: Ongoing guardianship supplies continuity across changing conditions.
Directed flow links stable practice to movement through an unstable medium.
Firm knowledge prevents conviction from depending entirely on the current sea-state.
The ship supplies a bounded carrier that moves through surrounding water.
Flowing movement supplies ordinary continuity before crisis.
Recognition of benefit names the disposition that should survive the passage.
Interpenetrating turbulence supplies the destabilizing crisis-state.
Exclusive devotion strips away rival dependencies under pressure.
Rescue by separation marks the abrupt transition into safety.
Moderation after rescue measures how much of crisis-devotion persists.

structural_cues: The two-ayah sequence changes state from smooth sailing to covering waves, singular appeal, rescue to land, and divided post-rescue response.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies state-change and inconsistent persistence; I infer repeated practice -> lower devotional volatility, while a live alternative is simply a warning against crisis-only sincerity.

changed_reading.before: Prayer, zakat, and certainty are stable badges displayed in ordinary life.
changed_reading.after: They are practices for carrying integrity across volatility, so devotion and gratitude do not disappear when crisis gives way to safety.

context_deltas.mechanism: 31:33 denies reciprocal parent-child substitution and warns against deceptive appearances. Zakat can truly support another now, but certainty in the later end prevents social transfer from being mistaken for transfer of final agency; the split-root harvest image adds an exploratory maturity boundary for each growth trajectory.

activation_trace.role: Giving establishes real present transfer between persons.
Growth preserves the genuine benefit of that transfer.
The final laterness supplies the boundary at which substitution fails.
Stable knowledge keeps present generosity joined to irreducible final agency.
One thing standing in another's place precisely names the substitution denied in both directions.
The non-dominant harvest-time image tentatively casts judgment as the maturity boundary of each separate growth trajectory.
A shine that does not endure supplies the deceptive appearance that present ties can erase the final boundary.
Ignorance of outcome sharpens why the later horizon must discipline present confidence.

structural_cues: Parent and child are placed in a reciprocal negative construction, followed by a true-promise assertion and a doubled warning against deception.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies denied substitution plus a split harvest branch; I infer social aid does not transfer final agency and tentatively add growth -> individual harvest, while the live alternative keeps only the juridical non-substitution reading.

changed_reading.before: Zakat transfers benefit to another and afterlife certainty promises its eventual return.
changed_reading.after: Zakat binds persons in real present support while the later end marks the exact limit of transfer: no gift, kinship, or proxy can replace another's final agency.

context_deltas.mechanism: 31:34 withholds the hour, rain, womb-content, tomorrow's earning, and place of death from human mastery. It revises yqinin in 31:4 from exhaustive prediction to stable orientation toward the afterlife while its schedule and one's route into it remain unknown.

activation_trace.role: The final later horizon is what remains affirmed without disclosure of its particulars.
Fixed knowledge supplies confidence, but not ownership of every future datum.
Life-giving rain supplies a beneficial future event whose timing remains outside human command.
Knowing and discernment are explicitly negated for the self's tomorrow and death-place.
Seeking and obtaining benefit supplies the ordinary future activity that cannot be prepossessed as data.
The next day supplies the nearest future and shows that uncertainty is not confined to remote eschatology.
Loss of life supplies the certain boundary whose location remains withheld.

structural_cues: Exclusive divine knowledge frames the ayah at both ends; two indefinite selves repeat the negative knowing construction, and the hour itself lacks a usable branch inventory image.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies asserted certainty in 31:4 and withheld particulars in 31:34; I infer certainty of orientation != exhaustive forecast, while a live alternative limits 31:34 to divine omniscience without redefining human yaqinin.

changed_reading.before: Those who are certain of the afterlife possess firm information about the future.
changed_reading.after: Their certainty is disciplined trust in the final horizon precisely without mastery of its time, tomorrow's gain, or the place by which they reach it.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The fire-straightening branches are surprising and form-distant from lexical prayer, but they remain anchored in the focus's two prayer mappings and q-w-m straightness, with 31:21 supplying an actual flame contrast. Render only as a material analogy for formation, never as a replacement definition of salah.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Words 2-3 join straight establishment to salah, allowing the heat and straightening branches of the same prayer root to remain visible.

activation_trace.role: Straightness supplies the disposition that repeated practice is imagined to produce.
Meeting heat supplies the testing or tempering medium.
Heating and straightening a thing supplies the exploratory formative mechanism.
Kindled flame supplies the destructive heat toward which unformed following can be summoned.

changed_reading.before: Prayer is a correctly maintained ritual contrasted with later punishment by fire.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, prayer is repeated tempering: exposure that straightens the self so it does not follow a summons into consuming heat.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The protected-seclusion branch of y-q-n is remote from ordinary certainty and should not be lexicalized as its meaning. It remains anchored at the focus root, while the visible/hidden pairing and covering wave make guarded interiority a live psychological analogy; downstream prose must label it exploratory.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Word 9's y-q-n branch and the emphatic doubled pronoun around the fronted later horizon can support an image of conviction held in an interior reserve.

activation_trace.role: Protective seclusion supplies the odd but exact-root image of an interior kept from exposure.
Outward disclosure supplies one side of the blessing field.
Hidden inwardness supplies the other side and legitimates attention to an interior register.
An overlying cover supplies pressure that can occlude ordinary orientation.
An overhead canopy gives the engulfing wave a containing spatial form.

changed_reading.before: Certainty is an exposed cognitive assertion about a future fact.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, certainty also acts as a guarded interior reserve that keeps orientation intact when visible conditions close over the person.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Reading z-k-w through pairing is branch-distant from the lexical zakat in context, but the focus's parallel verbs and 31:10's joined pair keep the activation anchored. Render as compositional symbolism: prayer and zakat work as a pair, not as a claim that zakat literally means pairing here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The parallel verbal objects at words 2-5 place prayer and zakat side by side, with z-k-w itself retaining a pair branch.

activation_trace.role: Support supplies the stabilizing member of the proposed pair.
A directed channel supplies the outward-moving member of the proposed pair.
Pair and evenness explicitly activate a coupled rather than isolated practice reading.
A counterpart joined to its mate supplies the contextual generative pair image.

changed_reading.before: Prayer and zakat are independent duties that happen to share a sentence.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, they are a generative pair: one stabilizes the receiving structure and the other opens its provision into outward circulation.

strongest_changes: Prayer and zakat shifted from adjacent duties to stabilizing and circulating functions within one practice ecology.
The exact prayer repetition in 31:17 extended ritual posture into command, restraint, endurance, gait, and voice.
The shared a-t-y root in 31:16 made tiny hidden giving specifically retrievable within the later horizon.
31:33 bounded social transfer by final non-substitution, while its split root preserved an exploratory harvest reading.
31:34 revised certainty from future-data possession to stable orientation under withheld particulars.
summary.what_was_special: The most productive activations were material and structural rather than topical: support/channel/growth, carrying/weaning, hidden-seed retrieval, temporal cadence, and crisis-state continuity. The odd y-q-n protection, s-l-w tempering, z-k-w pairing, and split j-z-y harvest branches remained live but explicitly contained.
remaining_uncertainties: The watercourse and ecological circuit may be a strong material analogy without being a governing lexical sense in 31:4.
The extension from prayer posture to 31:17-19 public conduct may reflect deliberate sequence or merely adjacent counsel.
The protective y-q-n, tempering s-l-w, paired z-k-w, and harvest j-z-y activations are exact-branch anchored but form-distant.
The bounded-certainty reading depends on treating 31:34 as a revision of human epistemic posture rather than only a statement of divine omniscience.
